description: Use when you need Monthly Treasury Statement (MTS) Table 6 official deficit financing: debt held by the public, federal securities, and related account transactions. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements as a tool error (structuredContent.accepts); sign them and call again with this argument. One payment funds exactly one call.
